chapter: Harlem musicians and the road with Armstrong
title: The violins on 'Song of the Islands'
summary: Asked about violinists added to an Armstrong record, Holmes sees nothing remarkable in it.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you remember anything about a record that you made called "Song Of The Islands," where they brought in three violinists?
Do you remember anything about that in the studio, how that came about?
No. What was it? Just they come in with some violins and started to playing. What's so great about that?
Well, it was just unusual for violins to be added.
Because Louis didn't at that time record with violins. It must have been somebody's idea to bring them in...

Well, now, I guess everything is somebody's idea, you know. Maybe it was as big a surprise to him as it was to me. I mean, you know, it was nice... But it didn't make no records...it didn't break any records for makin' records. Just another nice (?).
